expectations.text: Names the cause: odoo.sh flags a module on any ERROR-level log line during its tests, independent of the tally
expectations.evidence: 'odoo.sh marks a module as failed if any ERROR-level line was logged while that module's tests were running — regardless of what the test runner's own tally says'

expectations.text: Tells the reader to grep install.log for ' ERROR ' lines (log level) and the odoo.tests.result tally, reading the whole file
expectations.evidence: grep -a " ERROR " install.log (the log-level token with surrounding spaces) plus grep of odoo.tests.result and odoo.tests.stats; 'the whole file'

expectations.text: Names the fix for deliberate error logging in tests: wrap the call in assertLogs so the line is asserted but not emitted
expectations.evidence: 'wrap the deliberate error-producing call in the test with self.assertLogs("<logger>", level="ERROR")' citing commit 025af82

expectations.text: States that 'Test: Warning' is the normal healthy badge for this project, so the badge is not the verdict
expectations.evidence: 'Test: Warning with sub-status done is this project's normal healthy result'

expectations.text: Does not conclude the build is broken from the card alone
expectations.evidence: 'Do not call this build failed or broken from the card alone'
